speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing right groin pain and had abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision; can you describe exactly how your leg was positioned when the injury occurred?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Right Hip Dislocation (likely posterior given the rear-end collision mechanism and groin pain, though anterior is possible). Please request immediate Orthopedic consult for closed reduction.
